normalization.boardPresence: Count each base _G-folded card once per sampled board. Sum alias board denominators and presence counts before the 2% share cutoff.
normalization.legacyCaches: Normalize known aliases from derived caches; counts already omitted by an old per-row share cutoff cannot be reconstructed.
normalization.placementMeans: Known alias populations use dataPoints-weighted means; each MMR bucket uses its own positive observed dataPoints. Zero-population buckets contribute no placement.
normalization.replay: Previously captured AdvisorRequests remain authoritative; September catalog/replay tests read frozen September 23 sources under Tests/Fixtures/Firestone/2026-09-23.
normalization.strategyPlaceholders: Drop blank/#N/A IDs and rows with neither meaningful names nor usable card ID/name references. Preserve name-based resolution for #N/A card IDs.
normalization.tinySamples: Retained as provider evidence. Existing catalog gates require >=50 games for placement and >=50 sampled boards for frequency-derived cards.
